def transform(grid):
    """Portal/beam rule: markers beam toward the nearest portal segment aligned on their
    row/column, become 4, trail their color to the portal, then continue from the paired
    portal segment at the matching offset, painting onward in the same direction."""
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=most_common(g)
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    # candidate runs of non-bg colors
    runs=[]
    for r_ in range(H):
        c_=0
        while c_<W:
            if g[r_][c_]!=bg:
                c2=c_
                while c2+1<W and g[r_][c2+1]==g[r_][c_]: c2+=1
                if c2-c_+1>=2: runs.append(('h',r_,c_,c2,g[r_][c_]))
                c_=c2+1
            else: c_+=1
    for c_ in range(W):
        r_=0
        while r_<H:
            if g[r_][c_]!=bg:
                r2=r_
                while r2+1<H and g[r2+1][c_]==g[r_][c_]: r2+=1
                if r2-r_+1>=2: runs.append(('v',c_,r_,r2,g[r_][c_]))
                r_=r2+1
            else: r_+=1
    run_cells=defaultdict(set)
    for o,a,b,e,col in runs:
        cells=((a,cc) for cc in range(b,e+1)) if o=='h' else ((rr,a) for rr in range(b,e+1))
        run_cells[col].update(cells)
    portal_colors={col for col,cells in run_cells.items() if len(cells)==cnt[col]}
    segs=[r_ for r_ in runs if r_[4] in portal_colors]
    pc=portal_cells(segs)
    seg_of={}
    for i,(o,a,b,e,col) in enumerate(segs):
        cells=((a,cc) for cc in range(b,e+1)) if o=='h' else ((rr,a) for rr in range(b,e+1))
        for cell in cells: seg_of[cell]=i
    markers=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(H) for cc in range(W)
             if g[rr][cc]!=bg and (rr,cc) not in pc]
    jobs=[]
    for (mr,mc) in markers:
        col=g[mr][mc]
        best=None
        for (pr,pcn) in pc:
            if pr==mr: cand=(abs(pcn-mc),'h',1 if pcn>mc else -1)
            elif pcn==mc: cand=(abs(pr-mr),'v',1 if pr>mr else -1)
            else: continue
            if best is None or (cand[0],cand[1])<(best[0],best[1]): best=cand
        if best is None: continue
        _,axis,s=best
        path=[]
        if axis=='h':
            cc=mc+s
            while 0<=cc<W and (mr,cc) not in pc: path.append((mr,cc)); cc+=s
            if not (0<=cc<W): continue
            enter=(mr,cc)
        else:
            rr=mr+s
            while 0<=rr<H and (rr,mc) not in pc: path.append((rr,mc)); rr+=s
            if not (0<=rr<H): continue
            enter=(rr,mc)
        si=seg_of[enter]
        o,a,b,e,pcol=segs[si]
        others=[j for j,(o2,a2,b2,e2,c2) in enumerate(segs) if j!=si and c2==pcol]
        if not others: continue
        o2,a2,b2,e2,_=segs[others[0]]
        off=(enter[1]-b) if o=='h' else (enter[0]-b)
        kk=min(off,e2-b2)
        exits=[(a2,b2+kk)] if o2=='h' else [(b2+kk,a2)]
        jobs.append({'src':(mr,mc),'path':path,'col':col,'axis':axis,'s':s,'exits':exits})
    for j in jobs: g[j['src'][0]][j['src'][1]]=4
    for j in jobs:
        for (rr,cc) in j['path']:
            if (rr,cc) not in pc: g[rr][cc]=j['col']
        for (er,ec) in j['exits']:
            if j['axis']=='h':
                cc=ec+j['s']
                while 0<=cc<W and (er,cc) not in pc:
                    g[er][cc]=j['col']; cc+=j['s']
            else:
                rr=er+j['s']
                while 0<=rr<H and (rr,ec) not in pc:
                    g[rr][ec]=j['col']; rr+=j['s']
    return g
